publicStore.trackName: SIGNAL - 個人発信を追うニュースアプリ
publicStore.description:
SIGNALは、個人発信者の更新を静かに追うためのニュースフィードアプリです。
note、Qiita、Zenn、はてなブックマーク、DevelopersIOなどから、個人やクリエイターの発信を中心に表示します。
広告はなく、個人情報の収集も行いません。通知に追われず、自分のペースで情報を確認できます。

アプリ内での反応をもとに、表示順は少しずつ調整されます。
これらのデータは端末内で管理され、外部へ送信されることはありません。

SIGNALは、個人の発信を主軸にしながら、必要な話題も確認できるフィードアプリです。

supports: iOS deployment target 13.0 matches public Store minimumOsVersion
Built-in sources; note pinned magazine only
GOOD/BAD and reading activity influence refreshed ranking; learning state is local
Original articles open in WebView; article text-size and theme settings
Source enabled switches; no user-facing arbitrary custom-source management or bookmark/summary UI

decisions: Built-in individual/creator article sources and separate news tab, settings to select enabled sources, original article reading and local learning are included.
The Japanese-only current app interface is stated in all six locale notes, based on public languageCodesISO2A [JA]. Website translations do not imply app localization.
No claim that users can manually follow any arbitrary author, add arbitrary RSS, read all pages offline, obtain AI summaries, search or bookmark. Current README explicitly excludes those interfaces.
No price or free-tier claim was added to product copy. Existing approved formal screenshots include an original small free/no-ad label; images were unchanged.
